subprocess_flow.description: Execute statistical parity checks, disparate impact assessments, and demographic group performance comparisons across protected characteristics. This sub-step identifies disparate false positive and negative rates to verify conformance with statutory fairness baselines in judicial decision support.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: Disparate impact ratio meets statutory threshold (0.80 to 1.25 parity rule)
Demographic performance parity metrics evaluated across all Equality Act 2010 protected characteristics
subprocess_flow.purpose: Quantify and detect potential demographic skew and disparate treatment across sensitive population cohorts.
subprocess_flow.scope: Validation datasets, demographic cohorts, and model inference distributions.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of security clearance and finalized model training validation outputs
end_conditions: Disparate Impact & Bias Evaluation Matrix generated and approved by independent auditor

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Undetected disparate treatment across sub-populations in criminal justice assessments
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated multi-metric fairness evaluation covering equal opportunity, equalized odds, and disparate impact

governance_requirements: Equality Act 2010 Public Sector Equality Duty
EU AI Act Article 10 (Data and Data Governance)
UK National AI Strategy Ethical Principles

change_management.change_request_process: Fairness metric rule updates submitted via MLOps registry ticket
change_management.versioning_rules: Evaluation matrices versioned with semver matching model artifact Git commit tag

subprocess_flow.description: Evaluate model interpretability and explainability methods including SHAP and LIME feature attributions. The auditor validates local and global explanations to ensure operational staff and legal professionals can understand, contest, and document automated recommendations.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: Feature importance and attribution consistency verified against domain expectations
High-risk prediction rationale interpretable by non-technical judicial personnel
subprocess_flow.purpose: Ensure algorithmic recommendations are transparent, explainable, and legally contestable.
subprocess_flow.scope: Global and local model explainability methods, surrogate models, and feature attribution scores.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Completion of disparate impact and bias evaluation
end_conditions: Sign-off of Explainability Assessment Dossier by lead auditor

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Black-box decisions incapable of judicial review or individual explanation
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory extraction and validation of local SHAP explanation vectors for sample case studies

governance_requirements: EU AI Act Article 13 (Transparency and provision of information to deployers)
CDDO Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS) Tier 2

change_management.change_request_process: Interpretability baseline adjustments reviewed through AI Technical Review Panel
change_management.versioning_rules: Explainability dossier linked cryptographically to model artifact hash

improvement_inputs: Explainability feedback from legal and operational users

subprocess_flow.description: Establish and validate operational human oversight mechanisms, fail-safe interventions, and manual override capabilities. This sub-step defines criteria under which human caseworkers or judicial officers review, override, or escalate AI recommendations before decisions take effect.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: Human-in-the-loop decision boundaries and escalation triggers documented and tested
Override interface and reason-logging workflows validated for operational caseworkers
subprocess_flow.purpose: Guarantee that autonomous AI systems cannot make binding legal or correctional decisions without meaningful human oversight.
subprocess_flow.scope: Operational decision paths, user interfaces, override logging mechanisms, and casework protocols.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Completion and validation of model explainability dossier
end_conditions: Human-in-the-Loop Protocol Specification approved by operational leads and independent auditor

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Automation bias leading human operators to rubber-stamp erroneous or biased predictions
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory recorded rationale for casework overrides and random human review sampling

governance_requirements: UK National AI Strategy Ethical Principles on Accountability

change_management.change_request_process: Operational oversight protocol updates approved by Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO)
change_management.versioning_rules: Protocol specifications versioned in accordance with enterprise SOP guidelines

subprocess_flow.description: Synthesize results from demographic parity testing, explainability evaluations, and human oversight validation into an auditable final conformance assessment. The independent auditor conducts final verification and issues formal sign-off for governance gate progression.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Independent Model Auditor / Quality Assurance Lead
success_criteria: 100% resolution or approved mitigation of critical model bias findings
Formal auditor endorsement and signed Independent Model Audit Report
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide definitive, independent assurance of ethical, legal, and regulatory compliance prior to stage-gate submission.
subprocess_flow.scope: All empirical assessment artifacts, mitigation logs, and independent assurance attestations.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Completion of human-in-the-loop oversight protocol specification
end_conditions: Independent auditor endorsement and sign-off of fairness and explainability report

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Deployment of non-compliant AI model due to unaddressed bias or lack of auditability
step_risks_and_controls.control: Strict gating requiring cryptographic sign-off from Independent Model Auditor prior to gate progression

governance_requirements: UK National AI Strategy Ethical Principles
EU AI Act High-Risk System Requirements (Articles 9-15)

change_management.change_request_process: Remediation retraining requests submitted to MLOps registry and tracked in Jira
change_management.versioning_rules: Final audit reports signed with digital certificate and stored with 7-year retention
